claim: Surface cloze prediction of a held-out reflex from another lect's held-out form and the reflex's surrounding surface context; not proto-form reconstruction or sound-law discovery.
selection_nesting: Every outer training partition rebuilds its feature vocabulary, alignments and greedy environment decision list. The list is frozen before its held-out dependency components are aligned and scored.
split_unit: Connected components under equal nonempty cognate_id, etymon_group or source_group. Alternate reflexes, paradigm cells and source-linked rows therefore cannot cross the split.
hyperparameters: All training and predictive settings are fixed before the outer run; none is selected from held-out scores.
alignment: Held-out forms are aligned anew under the fold-trained model. Prediction is decomposed to 1:1 reflexes so promoted chunks cannot remove hard changed segments from the denominator.
orientation: Every observed lect pair is trained and scored in both directions.
multilect: For at least three present lects, leave-one-lect-out predictions pool the other lects by an equal-weight geometric mean of categorical probabilities.
inventory: Candidate reflexes come only from the training partition. Test-only reflexes use an explicit unknown category and count as uncovered.

baselines.feature_distance: softmax of negative merkmal segment distance

metrics.top_k: exact reflex coverage; unknown reflexes are failures
metrics.calibration: 10-bin expected calibration error plus multiclass Brier score
metrics.abstention: max probability below 0.5; log loss still includes the observation

confirmation.corpus: completed grouped validation and positive unconditioned-minus-conditioned log-loss gain
confirmation.association: exact association rediscovered in at least two folds, at least eight held-out observations, and positive gain
confirmation.small_corpus: descriptive_only when at least two train and two test dependency groups cannot be maintained

gates: segmental synthetic and Old/Modern English strata have positive overall gain
a cross-dimensional association has predictive confirmation
multi-lect conditioned pooling beats unconditioned pooling
every real-negative corpus has non-positive gain
the test-only x reflex remains unseen rather than entering the fold vocabulary
